title: HTTP 5xx rate above threshold
summary: 5xx rate on POST /checkout has been above the error budget burn rate for six minutes. Card payments are failing for a subset of customers.

title: HTTP 5xx rate above threshold
summary: Same alert firing in staging while the team is load-testing a release candidate.

title: Nightly report job exceeded runtime
summary: The nightly revenue report took longer than its usual window but completed successfully. No consumer reads it before 09:00.

title: Login success rate dropped
summary: Successful logins fell sharply across all regions. Customers report being unable to sign in. No deploy in the last hour.

title: Kafka consumer lag growing
summary: Consumer lag on the product-index topic is climbing steadily. Search results are going stale but still serving.

title: Certificate expires soon
summary: TLS certificate for the internal wiki is approaching expiry. Renewal is automated and has not run yet.

title: Pod restarted
summary: One pod restarted after an OOM kill and rejoined the pool. Traffic was served by the other four throughout, no customer impact observed.

title: Disk usage above 85 percent
summary: Warehouse volume is filling. At the current growth rate there is roughly a week of headroom. Nothing is failing yet.

title: SMS provider returning errors
summary: The upstream SMS gateway is rejecting a portion of sends. Two-factor codes are not reaching some customers. Email fallback is unaffected.

title: Runner queue depth high
summary: Builds are queuing during the European morning peak. Developers wait longer for CI. Nothing customer-facing.

title: Sync job failed
summary: The hourly CRM sync failed with a timeout. It has failed intermittently for months and self-heals on the next run. The team has an open ticket to retire this service.

title: Origin latency spike
summary: Origin response time spiked for ninety seconds and recovered on its own. Cache hit ratio held, so almost no requests reached origin.
